messages.content: C大調音階中的第三個主要和弦是什麼？

function.name: get_third_chord
function.description: Calculate the third major chord in a given key. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The third major chord would be the chord built on the third degree? But they say "third major chord". Usually we refer to diatonic triads: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major, the major chords are I (C), IV (F), V (G). The third major chord would be G? Actually the major chords are I, IV, V. So the third major chord is V: G major. But the phrase "第三個主要和弦" could mean the third chord in the progression of major chords?
